name: ▼Habitat Unknown
note: <NoBookData>

name: Karakuri Torechiki
note: <NoBookData>

name: Mischief Box
note:
<CategoryKey:生息地不詳>
<text:Trap Monster
Habitat unknown

A monster like a girl hiding in treasure chests.
It attacks those who reveal themselves,
dragging them into its lair.

There are often victims near traps,
so observe carefully.>

name: Destreasure
note:
<CategoryKey:生息地不詳>
<text:Trap Monster
Habitat unknown

The girl and the box are separate individuals.
In other words, this monster comes in pairs.

Occasionally, one may wander off.>

name: Overkill
note:
<CategoryKey:生息地不詳>
<text:Trap Monster
Habitat unknown

Men will open this box even knowing it's a trap,
because when the monster inside drains their mana,
they experience unparalleled pleasure.>

name: ▼Opening - Pebble Path
note: <NoBookData>

name: Fishing Light
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Flame Monster
Primarily found on Rakumei Beach.

A fire apparition that rises offshore.
Common in the Eastern Lands,
it occasionally emits sparks and startles people.>

name: Sea Sprite
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Octopus Monster
Primarily found on Rakumei Beach.

A bizarre octopus that floats effortlessly.
Its aimless drifting has led it to be likened
to a soul after death.>

name: Skull Rope
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Bone Monster
Primarily found in Yorose Tower.

An entity formed from scattered bones linked together.
It resembles a snake, but it is not a snake bone monster.

The reason for their connection is unknown.
Perhaps the corpses gained a sense of unity.>

name: Dark Furball
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Soot Monster
Primarily found in Yorose Tower.

Just as small particles gather to form soot,
darkness too can sometimes coalesce into a mass.

The areas where they exist become dusty.
It's best to cover your nose and mouth.>

name: Nocturne
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Corpse Monster
Primarily found in Yorose Tower.

A small corpse with an innocent demeanor,
having forgotten its past misfortunes.

Its unnatural strength is proof
that it is no longer human.>

name: Shibagumi Soldier, Rokumaki Nao
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Shibagumi Soldier (Kimen)
Encountered in Yoyose Tower.

A good-natured person who only looks straight ahead.
Perhaps that's why she sometimes comes into conflict.

No matter how many times she falls, she rises again.
It is that resolve that moves her.>

name: Monk of Nezuka
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Human Monster
Encountered on Rakumei Beach.

In ancient times, the Four-Soul Apparition
appeared to the monks of Star Treasure Temple.
That was a discovery of one truth.

Ten thousand eyes, a hundred serpents devouring a thousand corpses,
through ten wombs, they reach one.>

name: Roumon
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Rat Monster
Primarily found in Old Sasakura Town.

A large rat found in mountainous regions.
Its aggressive nature is a cover for its timidity,
and its behavior has become a proverb in the Eastern Lands.>

name: Ishizumi
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Stone Monster
Primarily found in Old Sasakura Town.

Naturally piled-up stones.
They are said to harbor pure and innocent souls,
and as if to prove it, they are weak to darkness.>

name: Sakurakuma
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Bear Monster
Primarily found in Old Sasakura Town.

A fierce beast with fur resembling cherry blossoms.
Many let their guard down and approach it because of its beauty.

Sakurakuma doesn't understand
why its prey comes to it of their own accord.>

name: Namubeta
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Soft-bodied Monster
Primarily found in Old Sasakura Town.

A slow-paced monster.
Even non-adventurers can easily escape it,
and its danger level is low.

However, there is an entity that leads the Namubeta.>

name: Namufima
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Soft-bodied Monster
Primarily found in Old Sasakura Town.

The entity that leads the Namubetas,
in a strict superior-subordinate relationship with them.

It is slow, and escape should be easy,
but there are many who do not do so,
because it feels nice and slippery.>

name: Odoro
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:An evil monster
Primarily inhabits Ishihiroi Path

The most common pest in the Eastern Lands
When speaking of evil occurrences, this is what comes to mind

A type of enemy one can never reach an understanding with
Mercy should be cast aside>

name: Udara
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:An evil monster
Primarily inhabits Ishihiroi Path

In the Eastern Lands, it is the most common pest next to the Odoro
When people speak of evil occurrences, this is one that comes to mind

One's eyes are drawn to the part that looks like a harmless face,
but one must not overlook its massive claws>

name: Tsukimimi
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:A rabbit monster
Primarily inhabits Ishihiroi Path

A large rabbit occurrence
Full of curiosity, it even becomes attached to people at times

Known for being fond of mischief
It probably just wants attention>

name: Yougarami
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:The Blight Root of the Yachimata Banyan
Encountered on Ishihiroi Path

A Shibagumi soldier whose soul was piteously devoured
Entwined by roots, it is no longer human

The Blight Root sprouts using the victim as a seedbed
Even if it was one's family member or one's master,
one must be certain to sever its head>

name: Ancient Capital Manslaughter
note:
<BoostEX:CR, 100>
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:A ghostly monster
Encountered in Shusuikyo

The spirit of a manslaughter who once terrorized the capital
A practitioner of the hidden arts of the now-obsolete Hakutou Style

A blinded swordsman cut down a comrade spiraling into madness
Still, the incident did not come to an end>

name: Nedachi-douji
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Oni Monster
Encountered on Kanmui Trail.

An oni that severs the roots spreading underground.
Whether it knows they are evil or not,
simply tearing them apart is fun.

Thus, it is a being that serves the world.>

name: ▼Takizen Mountain - Whispering Cemetery
note: <NoBookData>

name: Tama-usagi
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:A rabbit monster
Primarily inhabits the Ryuuzenzan Main Approach

A monster that moves by hopping and bouncing
Its spherical body has high elasticity,
sometimes heading in unintended directions against its will>

name: Yamaumibou
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:An octopus monster
Primarily inhabits the Ryuuzenzan Main Approach

An Umibou in the mountains
A being that feels somewhat contradictory, but
by the time an octopus is floating, it's already that way anyway>

name: Yashatsumuji
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:A wind monster
Primarily inhabits the Ryuuzenzan Main Approach

An existence that could be called an incarnation of wind
Its nature is close to that of a spirit

It disappears when moving
As it assimilates with the natural wind>

name: Hyakude
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:A centipede monster
Primarily inhabits Ryuuzenzan Shouhouji

A type of insect with a long body and many legs
Some of its legs function as arms,
and it seems to even be capable of using tools.>

name: Kimen-odoshi
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:A small ogre monster
Primarily inhabits Ryuuzenzan Shouhouji

A small and weak existence as far as ogres go
However, that is only among its own kind
From a human perspective, it possesses ample brute strength

It is called by a different name overseas, but
in recent years, this has been established as the correct one>

name: Nuppera
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:A mysterious monster
Primarily inhabits Ryuuzenzan Shouhouji

An unidentified mass
It wriggles like soft flesh, but
when touched, it is cold and hard.>

name: Dregs of the Twisted Soul, Kanienrumu
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:A child of Kanmui
Encountered at Ryuuzenzan Shouhouji

Kanmui was an occurrence who desired harmony with humans,
and many of its kin followed suit.

However, there were those whose soul's impulses overrode their very will,
causing them to become piteously warped.>

_original.name: 曲霊の芥、カニエンルム

name: Charm Forge
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:A monster of Mana
Mainly inhabits Riyuuya

Mana itself given form through magic
A type of magical creature

It is rare for these to be born naturally
In most cases, a magic wielder is nearby>

name: Armene
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Night Demon Monster
Primarily found in Reason Shop.

Night demons prefer male mana.
Therefore, men must be especially cautious.

An unsatisfied night demon is like a beast;
if you are not a woman, you should probably flee.>

name: Hana-no-Onito
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:A Night Demon monster
Mainly inhabits Riyuuya

A high-ranking existence even among Night Demons
Possessing immense magical power and the ability to charm,
she captivates all manner of beings

Her diminutive size is but a reflection of the power she harbors>

name: Hatengo
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Leaf Monster
Primarily inhabits Hazama-Tsukahara

A strange being covered in leaves.
It flies around at high speed while stirring up wind.

Said to be a flying oddity and kin to the tengu,
but the only thing similar is its long, extended nose.>

name: Akaraoni
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Oni Monster
Primarily inhabits Hazama-Tsukahara

Oni are renowned oddities,
with various tales told even beyond the sea.

It is said that red ones are brave,
rushing headlong to challenge any foe.>

name: Aomeoni
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Oni Monster
Primarily inhabits Hazama-Tsukahara

Oni are renowned oddities,
with various tales told even beyond the sea.

It is said that blue ones are cowardly,
always hiding in the shadow of the red.>

name: Tatari
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Soot Monster
Primarily inhabits Whispering Graveyard

A spirit after death, or a malicious soul―
so the legends say.

In truth, it is merely floating, gathered dust,
and if left alone, it poses little harm.>

name: Marumaru
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Many-Legged Monster
Primarily inhabits Whispering Graveyard

A large crustacean appearing in caves.
It curls up and moves by rolling,
and through that motion, it stores electricity in its body.>

name: Unfading Regret
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Ghost Monster
Encountered at Hazama-Tsukahara

An oddity that buried many foes in a war of old.
Its piercing cold is said to have even swept up blood relations.

Even after death, it harbored regrets and attachments,
and those feelings reached Kamuy,
awakening it as a soul, awaiting judgment.>

name: ▼ Split Valley - Abyss
note: <NoBookData>

name: Shadow Crow
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Crow Monster
Primarily inhabits Wakachi Valley

It has a black body like a shadow monster,
and acts as if it were one.

It conceals the weakness of its physical form.
It's clever.>

name: Riguraja
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Bone Monster
Primarily inhabits Wakachi Valley

A monster that seems to be made of linked bones
can only exist in places with many bones.
Most likely, those are not pleasant places.>

name: Hitohira
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Cloth Monster
Primarily inhabits Wakachi Valley

A strange monster that flutters in the breeze.
In the eastern lands, its arrival is seen as an ill omen,
and it startles those who lay eyes on it.>

name: Hotarubi
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Flame Monster
Primarily inhabits Marsh of Souls

A fire oddity that appears in dark places.
Sometimes relied upon as a light source,
but generally it is not friendly toward humans.>

name: Kosokoso
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Stone Monster
Primarily inhabits Marsh of Souls

A stone said to cry out every night.
Feared as the lament of a dwelling soul,
but the mystic tanuki consider it the first cry of birth,
and rejoice, saying it is auspicious.>

name: Shishiyorun
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Corpse Monster
Primarily inhabits Marsh of Souls

A small-statured corpse always possesses tremendous arm strength.
Extraordinarily so, belying its appearance.

It must want attention so badly.
It tenses up, trying to hold you back.>

name: Swamp Woman
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Liquid Monster
Encountered at Marsh of Souls

A widely known indigenous oddity in the East.
Infamous as one that lures to death.

Do not walk near the marsh's edge.
Do not take the hand that beckons from the depths.>

name: Monster Raccoon of the Farthest End
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Tanuki Monster
Encountered at Drum Village

A mystic tanuki appearing in an eerie village at the eastern end.
It tricks lost children and sometimes even drives them back to the capital.

Its rough welcome holds no malice or hostility―
just the concern of an old woman and a bit of mischief.>

name: Doro Odoro
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Evil Monster
Primarily inhabits Bell-Striking Cave

A common pest, of the Odoro variety.
Stronger and more troublesome.

A day of mutual understanding will never come.
Mercy should be cast aside.>

name: Daraudara
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Evil Monster
Primarily inhabits Bell-Striking Cave

A common pest, of the Udara variety.
Stronger and more troublesome.

Even its harmless-looking face has become hateful.
Better to cut it down without delay.>

name: Blood-stained Clothing
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Moth Monster
Encountered at Bell-Striking Cave

Being someone's tool was a joy,
and so it kept confirming its own worth.

Eventually, the time to wither and be discarded would come.
That fear alone drove Clothing to begin spinning life itself.>

name: Twisted Hateful Root
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Detested Root of Yachimoku-Garu
Encountered at Marsh of Souls

A twisted, floating detested root that possesses nothing.
It moves toward better corpses.

No will exists within it.
There is nothing to do but cut it down―if you do not wish for death.>

name: Banyan-Possessed
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Detested Root of Yachimoku-Garu
Encountered at Marsh of Souls

If the Garu entanglement is left undefeated,
it becomes a wandering seedbed, spreading seeds across the land.

Eventually they grow to an unmanageable number.
That war began just like that.>

name: Kotama
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Mysterious Monster
Primarily inhabits Forest of Slumber

A being of strange appearance.
Said to be a kind of spirit,
it brings small blessings to those it encounters.>

name: Konpaku
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Fox Monster
Primarily inhabits Forest of Slumber

A mysterious fox imbued with light.
Though it has the form of a beast, it is vague,
and its true nature is closer to that of a ghost.>

name: Tamayura
note:
<CS_下限HP:99,174>
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Fox Monster
Primarily inhabited the former Forest of Slumber

A humanoid fox occasionally seen among the Konpaku.
It resembles a ghost but has a physical form.

It abhors conflict and will not attack
until it feels danger to itself.>

name: Miko with a Camp Hat, Ten
note:
<MNKR_EnemyStateIconOffset:-20>
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Miko of Pure White Shrine
Encountered at the former Pure White Shrine

At a shabby shrine in a remote western land, all alone,
the miko stands as if waiting for something.

The sword god will surely return
and strike down that evil.

Because she wishes it, she puts her whole soul into testing her power.>

name: Sword Demon Fox, Hakutō
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Twin Remains of Kamuy
Encountered at the former Pure White Shrine

The great oddity, at the end of the Hazama-Tsukahara upheaval,
swung its blade against all evils that needed to be struck down.

It failed to reach them and shattered.
Yet its will was carried on.>

name: Twisted Root of Resentment
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Detested Root of Yachimoku-Garu
Encountered at the Lid of the Cave

A twisted foot soldier of the detested root.
Seeking corpses, it possesses all living beings
and devours their souls.>

name: Beast of the Hateful Root
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Detested Root of Yachimoku-Garu
Encountered at the Lid of the Cave

The detested root's purpose is not to eat souls,
but by doing so, it gains power, changes form,
and produces corpses more efficiently.>

name: Main Root of the Banyan
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Detested Root of Yachimoku-Garu
Encountered in Naraka

The main root extending from the source is the entire body;
if even one remains, it distributes power to the others
and quickly returns to its eightfold state.

Only by bringing them all down at once can you finally see―
the ancient blight, the chronic affliction of Shikinowa.>

name: Ancient Root of Calamity, Yachimata Banyan
note:
<反撃拡張:悪斬返し>
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Root of the Detested Root's Origin
Encountered in Naraka

The evil that revealed itself through fierce attacks.
The felled main root is regenerating,
each piece looking like a head.

When the eight serpents once rampaged through the cave,
a granted wish stirred existence itself.

That is how the eight-headed serpent was born.>

name: ▼Apunokonru-ED
note: <NoBookData>

name: Freeze Forge
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Mana Monster
Primarily inhabits Apunokonru

Mana itself given form through magic,
a kind of magical being.

Though it is rare for this to occur naturally,
it is not impossible.>

name: Pengil
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Bird Monster
Mainly inhabits Apunokonru.

A strange bird found in cold regions.
Unable to fly, but excels at swimming instead.

Usually appears sluggish,
but during hunts it slides over the ice and moves at high speed.>

name: Wengma
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Bear Monster
Mainly inhabits Apunokonru.

A fierce beast with white fur.
Blending into the snow, it sneaks up on prey.

Though strong, it never lets its guard down.
It is wise and cautious.>

name: Sephyon
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Rabbit Monster
Mainly inhabits Apunokonru.

A black rabbit that treats the snowy plains as its playground.
Its color stands out very much.

It doesn't hide because of strength;
rather, it expects its playmates to find it.>

name: Forest Snow Woman
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Snow Woman Monster
Encountered in the depths of the Lost Forest.

A monster living deep in the forest of Upashimoshiri.
It temporarily helps those who are lost and weakened.

That is the path to decadence.
Sometimes it becomes an ornate ice statue,
and other times, it forcibly makes them husband and wife.>

name: Kyukyukum
note:
<SE_身代わり対象限定:kkm>
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Soft-bodied Monster
Mainly inhabits the storehouse of Kotan.

This monster never acts alone;
it surrounds and protects a superior being of its kind.

They are all good friends.>

name: Kyukkimia
note:
<SE_身代わり対象者:kkm>
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Soft-bodied Monster
Mainly inhabits the storehouse of Kotan.

For this monster, its attendants are merely shields;
likely disposable and replaceable.

Nevertheless, they are all good friends.>

name: Settled Lost Child
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Trap Monster
Encountered in the storehouse of Kotan.

A monster well-known as a trap.
Because it was opened unexpectedly,
it reflexively bludgeons the one who did so.

There seems to be some misunderstanding.
This child does not have much hostility.>

name: Pokkuru
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Dwarf Monster
Mainly inhabits Kamuy Chashi.

A dwarf said to live in the remote eastern lands.
It resonates with starlight and wields that power.

There seem to be not a few friendly ones,
but most are timid and do not show themselves.>

name: Glacialta
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Ice Monster
Mainly inhabits Kamuy Chashi.

A being close to a spirit; a monster that appeared when the mana drifting in its habitat
contained the attributes of that land.

This one bears the Ice attribute.>

name: Porcien
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Octopus Monster
Mainly inhabits Kamuy Chashi.

A monster with immense magical power.
It features octopus tentacles and dog ears.

Fighting it head-on will inevitably result in a tough battle.
It is best to attack with Lightning attribute.>

name: Dragon Idol
note:
<反撃拡張:闇弱点>
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Stone Monster
Encountered at Kamuy Chashi.

Once a gatekeeper of the treasure hall built by the Blood Clan.
It continuously repelled the Uncrawling Ones.

Ironically, its limbs have now crumbled away,
and it has taken on a form resembling a snake.>

name: Nata Ogre
note:
<反撃拡張:怒りカウンター>
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Imp Monster
Mainly inhabits Mount Inochikoku.

An imp that wields a gigantic hatchet.
Its physical strength is extraordinary;
it cleaves enemy torsos in half, bones and all.>

name: Tsujikaze
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Wind Monster
Mainly inhabits Mount Inochikoku.

An incarnation of wind that carries malice.
It cuts apart everything that approaches.

Its blades are indiscriminate, even aimed at allies.
Therefore, it has poor relations with other species.>

name: Mujina
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Tanuki Monster
Mainly inhabits Mount Inochikoku.

A type of oddity very similar to the Mystic Tanuki.
It plays games of tricking enemies and then taking their lives.

Never confuse them.
Mujina is not a Mystic Tanuki. That would be quite outrageous.>

name: Oni of Inochikoku Mountain
note:
<反撃拡張:怒りカウンター>
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Oni Monster
Encountered at Mount Inochikoku.

That mountain is the land where the sun first rises,
and is worshipped as a symbol of the dawn of peace.

On its summit, an oni resides.
It enjoys the sunrise from the best seat.>

name: Demon-Masked Shiba-Gumi Soldier
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Oni-Faced Shibagumi Officer
Encountered at Mount Inochikoku.

A Shibagumi officer who covers their face with an oni mask.
Thus hiding their expression, never letting others see their hesitation.
Perhaps even hiding it from themselves.

No matter how many times they fall, they rise again.
It was only that resolve that drove her.>

name: Yomiumibou
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Octopus Monster
Mainly inhabits the Wandering Yomi Path.

An Umi-bou that dwells on the water bottom.
It drifts along with souls, like a soul itself.

There is nothing particularly unusual about it.
You might say it's an Umi-umi-bou.>

name: Yoinorinka
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Fox Monster
Mainly inhabits the Wandering Yomi Path.

A monster said to live in the afterlife.
Rarely, it crosses the boundary and appears in the living world.

Will-o'-the-wisps drift past the Yomi Path into the evening.>

name: Kenashi
note:
<CategoryKey:舟観>
<text:Mysterious Monster
Mainly inhabits the Wandering Yomi Path.

A mysterious lump of flesh standing in the darkness.
It has no face, but sometimes it twists eerily
as if forming expressions.>

name: Guide of the Reise River
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Ghost Monster
Encountered at the Wandering Yomi Path.

At the bottom of the sea, the River Rese where souls flow.
It is located in the underworld of the ruined city Wen-Marsas,
and is one of the pardons to leave no sediment.

The horse that accompanies the guide resembles a succubus,
but it is not; it is a kind of reaper.>

name: Former Shogun, Tokimiya Mugen
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Former Heavenly Conquest Grand General
Encountered at Toki Palace Castle.

A renowned general revived by being longed for.
His soul is housed in a decaying body.

He is far from his prime.
Yet all the feelings of himself and others
still rouse his wavering soul.>

name: Dragon Successor, Tokimiya Mugen
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Former Heavenly Conquest Grand General
Encountered at Toki Palace Castle.

Mugen, having unleashed the inherited power,
calls lightning and roars with the dragon's majesty.

Believing in the eternal peace the people desire,
and in the feelings sent to him, he wields his sword,
but he could never believe in himself,
who had bent his will for that sake.>

name: ▼After Clear
note: <NoBookData>

name: Dodoro
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Wicked Monster
Mainly inhabits the Dragon Palace.

An ancient beast of the pest Odoro.
A troublesome and annoying being.

Good and evil cannot be judged so easily,
but this one is undoubtedly evil.>

name: Dadara
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Wicked Monster
Mainly inhabits the Dragon Palace.

An ancient beast of the pest Udara.
A troublesome and annoying being.

Good and evil cannot be judged so easily,
but this one is undoubtedly evil.>

name: Onibi
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Flame Monster
Mainly inhabits the Dragon Palace.

A fire oddity that appears from the abyss.
It is a flame that scorches sinners and defiled souls,
and is one of the endless torments.>

name: Utsurogara
note:
<CategoryKey:冠鎮>
<text:Doll Monster
Mainly inhabits the Dragon Palace.

A type of mechanism resembling a chicken.
Without a soul, it inexplicably moves.

It might be a substitute,
or perhaps a trap.>

name: Dragon's Wet Nurse
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Snake Monster
Encountered at the Dragon Palace.

Something resembling a loathsome root in the palace devoid of the Blood Clan.
There is no sign of it trying to increase its kind.

After the snake's betrayal, they still vowed to coexist,
but the appearance of the Banyan twisted its existence.>

name: Marekotama
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Mysterious Monster
Mainly inhabits the entire area.

A being with a strange appearance.
It is said to be a kind of spirit,
but there is no basis for that explanation.>

name: Discord Larva
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Great Oddity of Shikinowa
Encountered in the entire area.

A soul awaiting the arrival of the next dragon.
It waits for the day it becomes Kamuy.

Coexistence with other species, domination of other species,
no one knows which is correct.
That is precisely why Kamuy is born, perhaps.>

name: Discord Larva
note: <NoBookData>

name: Kyokotsu
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Bone Monster
Mainly inhabits the Snake Village.

An oddity spoken of in various ghost stories.
All of them are related to death,
and when you face it, you will understand that is true.>

name: Mujouseki
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Stone Monster
Primarily inhabits the Serpent Village.

A collection of stones decayed in darkness.
Once it held light within,
but now there is no way of knowing.>

name: Koukon
note:
<CS_下限HP:99,174>
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Fox Monster
Primarily inhabits the Serpent Village.

A spirit fox seen in defiled lands.
It stares silently at those who visit.

It does nothing not because it lacks hostility,
but simply because it pities them.>

name: Monakushiru
note:
<CategoryKey:夜行岩屋>
<text:Star Monster
Primarily inhabits the Serpent Village.

A mysterious being that fell from the darkness high above the sky.
It is said to seep out with the death of a star,
but no one knows its true nature.>

name: Secret Illegitimate Child
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Stone Monster
Encountered in the Serpent Village.

A dragon effigy in the abyss.
This too was made by the Seseku people,
as a gift to the Tabi snakes.

After betrayal, it rotted at the bottom of the earth,
but drawing threads together, it still guards the abandoned village.>

name: Sealing Monk
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Human Monster
Encountered in the Abyss.

A monk who, at the end of his atonement for past lives, descended into the valley
and there witnessed the true root of calamity.

He was far too powerless against the enemy.
Defiled, he spent himself solely on sealing a meager life,
and simply awaited the coming hero.

Thus, a long time passed,
and by now even his sanity had faded.>

name: Uncrawling One
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Snake Monster
Encountered in the Serpent Village.

A being in a village at the bottom of the abyss.
It hides in the deep, muttering something endlessly,
and cuts down anyone who finds it.

Its personality is long gone;
perhaps even its life has already expired.
Only hatred, sorrow, and remorse
refuse to allow its soul to die.>

name: Karakuri Hyakuō, Shiba Dōji
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Four-Soul Aberration
Encountered at the Muen Hall.

One of the souls divided from Kamui.
It is spoken of as a great oni the size of a castle,
and bears the name Hyakuo Saiki.

The giant form is actually armed puppet mechanisms;
its hobby escalated to an extreme.>

name: Yuuyami of the Crossroads of the Lustrous Tail
note:
<反撃拡張:魅了体質>
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Four-Soul Aberration
Encountered in the Endless Corridor.

One of the souls divided from Kamui.
It is spoken of as a spirit fox that commands the Yotogi Oni,
and bears the name Gobi Yuuyami.

In modern times, it is the most well-known child of Kamui;
it runs a shop in the capital and enjoys the human world.>

name: Kakushigami Katari of the Eighty-Eight Divine Powers
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Four-Soul Aberration
Encountered at the Hidden Rock.

One of the souls divided from Kamui.
It is spoken of as the leader of the bake-danuki, the guide of night journeys,
and bears the name Youki Inugami.

In the eastern village, it is treated as a guardian deity,
and at the same time, a lifelong friend.>

name: Tanuki's Bewitchment
note: <NoBookData>

name: ▼ver1.10
note: <NoBookData>

name: Tonami-style Stone Doll
note: <NoBookData>

name: Soul Memory
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Mana Monster
Primarily inhabits the Womb Passage of the Nue.

Residual mana drifting through souls.
It sometimes acts autonomously and releases magic.

Perhaps it is a vestige of memory.>

name: Roaromon
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Rat Monster
Primarily inhabits the Sasakura Cemetery.

A subspecies of Romun. Extremely ferocious.
In battle it can only scratch,
but its movements are efficient and swift.>

name: Hihi Demon Head
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Part of the Nue's Body
Encountered at the Sasakura Cemetery.

A remnant left by Amei long ago.
This is the head.

It was vanquished by the former Onimen Squad's first Shiba-gumi captain,
Hobura Yukiharu.>

name: Kurokurou
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Crow Monster
Primarily inhabits the Nightglow Ground.

It has jet-black feathers that melt into the darkness.
At midnight, it is all but invisible,
but fortunately, it sleeps at night.>

name: Tobari
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Owl Monster
Primarily inhabits the Nightglow Ground.

A shinobi from the eastern island nation of Shikinowa.
It has feathers that make whatever they cover transparent,
and can hide not only itself but also its prey.>

name: Shadow Centipede
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Part of the Nue's Body
Encountered at the Nightglow Ground.

A remnant left by Amei long ago.
This is the tail.

It was vanquished by the head of the Kusakage-shu,
the Great Tengu.>

name: Storage
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Mysterious Monster
Primarily inhabits the Uni Circuit.

A box drifting in the sea of omniscience.
It is a recording medium, and is said to provide knowledge
to those with authority.>

name: Corpse-Eating Beast
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Part of the Nue's Body
Encountered at the Uni Circuit.

A remnant left by Amei long ago.
This is the limbs.

It should have been defeated by someone,
but who that was is unknown.>

name: Sharviisu
note:
<CategoryKey:ウパシモシリ>
<text:Heavenly Messenger
Primarily inhabits the Glass Town.

Beings that watch over the state of the world.
They are a race called angels, not monsters.

They reside in the heavenly town above.
Normally, they never descend to the ground.>

name: Manme Ikan
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Part of the Nue's Body
Encountered at the Glass Town.

A remnant left by Amei long ago.
This is the torso.

It was vanquished by the observer of the Void Era,
the Silver Angel Kesepher.>

name: Unknown Mystery, Nue
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Four-Soul Aberration
Encountered in the Womb Passage of the Nue.

One of the souls divided from Kamui.
Only its unknown nature is spoken of;
even its name is known to no one.

It journeyed all alone,
on a journey far too long.>

name: Monorocks
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Unicorn Monster
Primarily inhabits the Al-Warf Desert.

A large beast with a long, sharp horn.
It is said there is nothing its horn cannot pierce.

That is no exaggeration.
You must not take its charge on a shield or armor.>

name: Desert Melorin
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Dog Monster
Primarily inhabits the Al-Warf Desert.

A canine monster in the desert.
It moves as if guiding wandering travelers,
but even it doesn't quite understand itself,
so going together is dangerous.

It doesn't mean to deceive;
it just thinks it's doing a good deed.>

name: Destas
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Cactus Monster
Primarily inhabits the Al-Warf Desert.

A reddish-brown cactus.
It is not a plant; while blending into sandstorms,
it secretly casts death magic.>

name: Cactus Girl
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Cactus Monster
Primarily inhabits the Al-Warf Desert.

A reddish-brown cactus girl.
She stays still not because she's docile,
but because she's storing power for a counterattack.>

name: Desert Treasure
note:
<EnemyAtk:1200>
<EnemyAgi:1200>
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Trap Monster
Encountered in the Al-Warf Desert.

A hidden treasure in the desert.
What those who pursue it see last.

The treasure is you, who have arrived here.
Now, let us await the next treasure together.>

name: Spin Disc
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Machine Monster
Primarily inhabits the Gate of Burj.

A floating disc-shaped machine.
It flies around its habitat in regular patterns.

Blades extend outward from it,
and its attacks are surprisingly primitive.>

name: Orsa Mas
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Orsa Soldier (Sphere Type)
Primarily inhabits the Gate of Burj.

A mechanical doll powered by souls.
It stands still as if waiting for something,
and begins elimination upon detecting a dangerous presence.>

name: Gate Sealer
note:
<反撃拡張:水エラー>
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Orsa Soldier (Sphere Type)
Encountered at the Gate of Burj.

One of the sealers lying in wait at Burj.
One who guards the darkness that covers the sun.

In the modern era, the only old model.
It was extremely sturdy.>

name: Sacred Engraving Statue
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Stone Monster
Encountered at the Sacred Engraving Ruins.

A being that punishes those who impersonate warriors.
It stores light-attributed energy and unleashes it.

There is no precedent of this appearing.
After all, deceiving the gods is itself impossible.>

name: Koruruka
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Dwarf Monster
Primarily inhabits the Maya City Ruins.

A type of monster called a barbarian tribe.
They are dexterous, strong, and intelligent.
Many put their talents to use in crafting.

They have strong sexual desires.>

name: Cactus Barrel
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Cactus Monster
Mainly inhabits Maya's City Ruins.

A tall, elongated cactus.
It stays still and pretends to be harmless,
but its sheer size is intimidating.>

name: Cactus Fruit
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Cactus Monster
Mainly inhabits Maya's City Ruins.

A cactus resembling a young girl.
Usually it stays still like a plant,
but occasionally it begins to dance cheerfully.>

name: Void Sect Assassin
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Assassin Lurking in the Desert
Encountered at Maya's City Ruins.

A desert people called the Void Faction.
They lack humanity and have turned into monsters.

They too praise the gods,
but cannot accept those who do it differently.>

name: Dead Block
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Debris Monster
Mainly inhabits the Great Burj of Radiance.

It's considered a debris monster,
but in reality it's a black stain-like entity resembling a shadow.
It supposedly wraps itself in debris to hide,
but it actually stands out.>

name: Mumya
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Corpse Monster
Mainly inhabits the Great Burj of Radiance.

A corpse wrapped in long bandages.
When it senses life, it awakens from its coffin
and tries to bring death.

Despite appearances, it's lonely,
and wants you to die together with it.>

name: Sealer of Radiance
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Servant of the Enemy of God
Encountered at the Great Burj of Radiance.

One of the sealers awaiting in the Burj.
A guardian of the darkness that covers the sun.

The raptor-headed one is a child of the sun;
once it protected the radiance.>

name: Boldapion
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Scorpion Monster
Mainly inhabits the Afdal Highlands.

It has a carapace that can open and close.
Its interior is spacious enough for a small person to climb inside.

Unfortunately, it's not a comfortable space;
poison-soaked food is stored there.>

name: Hammer Bird
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Bird Monster
Mainly inhabits the Afdal Highlands.

A strange bird with a bludgeon tied to its crest.
It swings it around to smash enemies.

It's unusually hostile toward humans.
Maybe it holds a grudge.>

name: Ornithia
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Bird Monster
Mainly inhabits the Afdal Highlands.

A species consisting only of females.
They constantly seek males of other species to mate with.
Humans are said to be especially compatible.>

name: Ruf's Collector
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Mosquito Monster
Encountered at the Afdal Highlands.

A hard worker that uses a special device to gather wandering Rooves
and transports them to a managed location.

It doesn't seem to suck blood.
If you call it a mosquito, it gets quite upset.>

name: Bluemore
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Plant Monster
Mainly inhabits the Burj of Life.

A loathsome flower that grows from corpses as its seedbed.
It is reviled as an unlucky being symbolizing death,
but in reality it is a symbol of birth, sprouting from death.>

name: Berukimaira
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Hybrid Beast Monster
Mainly inhabits the Burj of Life.

A monster with high magical power and intelligence,
neither of which can be understood by human means.

It is an extremely rare, naturally born magical creature,
and has been the subject of various studies,
but no one has ever obtained any valuable results.>

name: Sealer of Life
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Servant of the Enemy of God
Encountered at the Burj of Life.

One of the sealers awaiting in the Burj.
A guardian of the darkness that covers the sun.

The beast-headed one is a weaver of Loof;
once it protected life.>

name: Cleavers
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Hyena Monster
Mainly inhabits the Sleeping Desert.

A beast that roams arid regions.
It scavenges carrion, crushes even bones,
and uses the fragments as weapons.>

name: Ophiophagus
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Serpent Monster
Mainly inhabits the Sleeping Desert.

A giant serpent with deadly venom.
It showers it in liquid form,
then follows up with magic.

Its ominous warning colors are the serpent's own form of mercy.>

name: Gula
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Corpse Monster
Mainly inhabits the Sleeping Desert.

A corpse activated by exposure to lightning.
It has considerable intelligence and immense magical power.

Gula eats human flesh.
To her, adventurers are food.>

name: Mana-starved One
note:
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Humanoid Monster
Encountered in the Sleeping Desert.

An unidentified being that wanders the desert seeking mana.

It is eerily quiet and slow,
but when hungry and discovering prey,
its ferocity becomes apparent.>

name: Rogue Maggot
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Maggot Monster
Mainly inhabits Orsa's Tomb.

The larva of the Fly Monster.
It appears and breeds in places rich in carrion.

It swarms together and gathers on a single piece of meat.
Many adventurers find this sight repulsive.>

name: Flyda
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Fly Monster
Mainly inhabits Orsa's Tomb.

The adult of the Maggot Monster.
It stores high magic power and casts wind magic.

Flies gather carrion for their larvae and build pillars out of it.
It's a noble activity necessary for raising young,
but to outsiders, it looks bizarre.>

name: Sealer of the Tomb
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Servant of the Enemy of God
Encountered at Orsa's Tomb.

One of the sealers awaiting in the Burj.
A guardian of the darkness that covers the sun.

The wolf-headed one is the warden of eternal sleep;
once it protected the peace of the dead.>

name: Rugenni
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Dwarf Monster
Mainly inhabits the Starfield on Earth.

The ancestor of the Eastern dwarves.
A type of spirit that lived in ancient times.

In the pure white country called Retal,
stood the Great Pure White Tree.>

name: Sashaha
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Fox Monster
Mainly inhabits the Starfield on Earth.

The ancestor of the Eastern spirit foxes.
A type of spirit that lived in ancient times.

In the pure white country called Retal,
there were people who could see through souls.>

name: Saraafa
note:
<CS_下限HP:99,174>
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Fox Monster
Mainly inhabits the Starfield on Earth.

The ancestor of the Eastern spirit foxes.
A type of spirit that lived in ancient times.

In the pure white country called Retal,
the harmony of the four seasons resided there.>

name: Tetra Device
note:
<CategoryKey:ラムルアラム>
<text:Machine Monster
Mainly inhabits Shamal Haram.

A machine used as a guard.
It exists to protect something,
and if that something is lost, it seeks a new target on its own.>

name: Al-Helm's Echo
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Enemy of God of Aswad
Encountered at Shamal Haram.

What lies at the end of a brave warrior's journey,
and something else apart from that.

Once, there was indeed an enemy there,
but now only echoes like these linger.>

name: Bird That Dreamed
note:

name: ▼ Al-Helm
note: <NoBookData>

name: Order Puppy
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Machine Monster
Mainly inhabits the Legend Management Tower.

A very old mechanical lifeform.
In days long past, it was used for security.

It looks like a puppy,
but you should not try to tame it.>

name: Order Dog
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Machine Monster
Mainly inhabits the Legend Management Tower.

A very old large mechanical lifeform.
In days long past, it served greatly for security.

Needless to say,
you should not try to tame it.>

name: Nemesis
note:
<EnemyAgi:1200>
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Insect Monster
Mainly inhabits Ibtisama.

The sworn enemy of mankind.
No explanation needed.>

name: Nora Merorin
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Dog Monster
Mainly inhabits Ibtisama.

A dog monster found in the town of Al-Helm.
Though toyed with by the iridescent light,
it runs around as it pleases, makes noise, plays,
and casually sprays urine here and there.>

name: Kokototo
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Lost Child Monster
Mainly inhabits Ibtisama.

The true form of the being known as the Trap Monster.
Having lost its treasure chest, it wanders aimlessly on its own feet.

It won't attack unless you anger it,
but once that happens, it will pursue you relentlessly.
Escape is difficult. You'll have no choice but to defeat it.>

name: Nemesis of the Ancient Age
note:
<EnemyAgi:1400>
<CategoryKey:ヌシ>
<text:Insect Monster
Encountered in Ibtisama.

The eternal enemy exists in every age,
and is the eternal enemy in every age.

Or perhaps, it could be called a specimen of tradition.>

name: Arc Disk
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Mechanical Monster
Mainly inhabits the Orsa Factory.

A floating disc-shaped machine.
It hovers while searching for enemies and monitors its surroundings.

Its spinning charge is extremely sharp,
capable of severing a person's limbs.>

name: Rufeless
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Spherical Orsa
Mainly inhabits the Orsa Factory.

An Orsa that has lost its power.
The reason it still moves is unclear,
but that is how monsters are born.>

name: Orsa Imrak
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Stone Monster
Encountered at the Orsa Factory.

The largest Orsa in Al-Helm.
It was not made for labor or defense,
but for a special purpose.

It requires a great deal of Roof to drive it,
and especially during generation, it affects its surroundings.>

name: Kotama Modoki
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Mysterious Monster
Mainly inhabits the Third Layer Research Facility.

A monster that looks just like Kotama.
In reality, it is something troublesome,
and there is little to gain from defeating it.>

name: Retaru Usagi
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Rabbit Monster
Mainly inhabits the Third Layer Research Facility.

A rabbit anomaly that lived in the White Country.
It has a habit of following whatever moves,
at least for a while.

The night is quiet.
It is busy looking at the moon.>

name: Anima Chimera
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Hybrid Beast Monster
Mainly inhabits the Third Layer Research Facility.

A chimera that manipulates souls.
In doing so, it builds conceptual connections
and unifies all knowledge into one.

In Retal, it was regarded as a godlike being,
and its divine arts served as the foundation.>

name: Octa Device
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Mechanical Monster
Mainly inhabits the Museum Ruins.

A machine that guards a set place.
When it detects a suspicious person, it begins pursuit
and attempts to destroy them with its mounted weapons.>

name: Expaldo
note:
<EnemyAgi:2400>
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Shadow Monster
Mainly inhabits the Museum Ruins.

A shadow monster shaped like a cat.
Its greatest trait is that it flees,
making it quite difficult to take down.

It was commonly seen in the age of myth.
Perhaps now it has grown tired of it all.>

name: Belmeria
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Dragon Monster
Mainly inhabits the Museum Ruins.

Dragons are known as an unparalleled race,
but dragonkin are the same.

And sometimes, there are those who surpass them.>

name: Orsa Ista
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Spherical Orsa Soldier
Mainly inhabits the Central Control Tower.

A mechanical doll that protects Al-Helm.
It continues to move even now by the will of Roof,
eliminating the vanguards of destruction.>

name: Orsa Zero
note:
<CategoryKey:アル・ヘルム>
<text:Spherical Orsa Soldier
Mainly inhabits the Central Control Tower.

A mechanical doll that protects Al-Helm.

They are not mistaken,
nor are they broken.

They have simply realized.>

name: Legacy Will
note:
<CategoryKey:boss>
<text:Souls of the Asuad People
Encountered at the Central Control Tower.

Their only thought is the divine tradition.

They praised the sun and martyred themselves for the future,
but now they weep in fear of loss.

The reason they bear the likeness of the warriors of old
is likely because they were symbols of the people's hope.>

name: Simulator
note:
<NoBookData>
<EnemyHP:10000000>
